acts.desc: Ira hears from a woman named Shannon about a phone call she got in 2008 that cast doubt on whether an 18 year old named Marie was telling the truth about being sexually assaulted. This idea leads to one of two investigations—one small and bad, and the other stunningly big and good.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: We go to Lynnwood, Washington to retrace the steps of a rape investigation gone undeniably wrong. Producer Robyn Semien and investigative reporter Ken Armstrong of the Marshall Project tell the story.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Our story continues two years later in Colorado where detectives in four neighboring towns combine resources to run down a serial rapist.

songs.a: Amy Black & “Shadow of Doubt” by Anne Weiss
